evidence.experimental_conditions: Guinea pig maximization test (GPMT) with DNCB challenge
evidence.support_text: The sensitization rate and scores of GPMT challenged by TCE or DNCB were calculated by the following formula: mean scores = (score of redness + score of swelling)/number of animals in the group.
